# Robot profile database (`Sim/data/robot_profile.db`)

<!-- Generated by `./gradlew :Sim:run --args="profile docs"` from Catalog.java. Do not edit by hand. -->

One SQLite file holds everything a game simulator needs to know about this robot: how fast it drives
and accelerates, how that changes as the battery sags under current draw, how accurate its shots are,
how its believed position drifts, and how long each game action takes. Any language can read it
(Python `sqlite3`, C# `Microsoft.Data.Sqlite`, JavaScript `better-sqlite3`/`sql.js`, Unity via a SQLite
plugin, or the JSON/CSV export).

Every value records **where it came from** (`source_kind`). Higher priority wins, so a sim never
overwrites a measurement:

| source_kind | meaning | priority |
|---|---|---|
| `measured` | logged on the real robot (HardwareMonitor import, shot/pose logs, scale, stopwatch) | 5 |
| `game_manual` | official BIOBUZZ Competition Manual | 5 |
| `manual` | typed in by a person (spec sheet, CAD, estimate) | 4 |
| `sim` | computed by the `Sim` module from real inputs | 3 |
| `placeholder` | example numbers, or sim output computed from any placeholder input. **Never trust.** | 1 |

An empty value (`NULL`) means "not known yet". `v_missing` lists what is still needed.

## Tables

| table | one row per | key columns |
|---|---|---|
| `meta` | setting | `key`, `value` (format, schema_version, season, robot_name, frames, units...) |
| `parameters` | single number or text | `key`, `value` / `text_value`, `unit`, `std_dev`, `role`, `required`, `source_id` |
| `curves` + `curve_points` | 1-D lookup table y(x) | `curve`, `x`, `y`, `y_std`, `n`; interpolate linearly, hold the end values outside the range |
| `surfaces` + `surface_points` | 2-D table z(x, y) | `surface`, `x`, `y`, `z`, `z_std`, `n`; bilinear between grid points |
| `distributions` + `distribution_samples` | random error / variation | `kind` (normal, uniform, triangular, lognormal, empirical, constant), `mean`, `std_dev`, `min`, `max`, `mode`, `per` |
| `actions` | timed game action | `mean_time_s`, `std_time_s`, `min_time_s`, `success_prob` |
| `shot_observations` | real shot (make/miss) | `ball`, `distance_m`, rpm/hood/battery..., `result` |
| `pose_observations` | real localization check | true vs estimated pose, `distance_driven_m`, `elapsed_s` |
| `sources` | batch of values | `kind`, `name`, `detail` (command, sessions, assumptions), `created_utc` |

Views: `v_parameters` (parameters with their source), `v_everything` (one row per entry of any type with
`has_data`), `v_missing` (required and still empty), `v_placeholders` (filled with placeholder data).

`role`: `input` = a property you put in, `derived` = computed by the sims from the inputs, `measured` =
from real-robot logs.

Curve notes for game sims:
- Where both exist, prefer a `*.measured_*` curve (real logs) over the sim curve at x values whose
  `n` is large (about 20+ shots or checks per bin); fall back to the sim curve elsewhere.
- Make-probability curves cover 0.5 m out to the field diagonal. Distances the robot cannot reach
  are stored as 0, so holding the end value never invents makes.
- `launcher.<ball>.hood_vs_distance` / `target_rpm_vs_distance` may hold two points 1 mm apart where
  the best arc switches (a big hood change). Interpolate between neighbours as usual; the pair keeps
  the two arcs from being mixed.

## Reading it

```python
import sqlite3
db = sqlite3.connect("robot_profile.db")
top = db.execute("SELECT value FROM parameters WHERE key='drive.max_speed_mps'").fetchone()[0]
pts = db.execute("SELECT x, y FROM curve_points WHERE curve='drive.time_to_distance' ORDER BY x").fetchall()
missing = db.execute("SELECT type, name FROM v_missing").fetchall()
```

```csharp
using var c = new SqliteConnection("Data Source=robot_profile.db"); c.Open();
var cmd = c.CreateCommand(); cmd.CommandText = "SELECT value FROM parameters WHERE key = $k";
cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("$k", "drive.max_speed_mps"); var top = (double?)cmd.ExecuteScalar();
```

Units are SI unless the name's suffix says otherwise (`_rpm`, `_deg`, `_dps`, `_mah`, `_ms`). Angles in the
data are degrees. Field frame: official FTC field coordinates (origin at the field center, +z up). Robot
frame: +x forward, +y left, yaw counter-clockwise positive.

How a game sim typically uses it: drive moves with `drive.time_to_distance` x `drive.path_overhead_factor`
(or `drive.time_to_distance_vs_battery` as the battery drains), shots with
`launcher.<ball>.make_prob_vs_distance` / `burst_make_prob_vs_distance_battery` and
`launcher.<ball>.burst_time_vs_battery_v`, intake/placing with `actions`, aim error from
`localization.position_error_vs_time`, and randomness from `distributions`.

## Contents

### `robot`

Whole-robot properties: mass, size, capacity.

| type | name | unit | role | req | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| parameter | `robot.mass_kg` | kg | input | yes | Total robot mass ready to play, battery included. |
| parameter | `robot.length_m` | m | input | yes | Frame length front to back. |
| parameter | `robot.width_m` | m | input | yes | Frame width side to side. |
| parameter | `robot.moi_kgm2` | kg*m^2 | input |  | Yaw moment of inertia about the robot center. Leave empty to estimate it as mass*(length^2+width^2)/12. |
| parameter | `robot.max_pollen_held` | count | input | yes | POLLEN the robot can hold at once. |
| parameter | `robot.max_nectar_held` | count | input | yes | NECTAR the robot can hold at once. |
| parameter | `robot.electronics_current_a` | A | input |  | Current drawn by hubs, sensors and idle servos when nothing moves. |

### `battery`

Battery and wiring: resting voltage and how much it sags per amp.

| type | name | unit | role | req | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| parameter | `battery.open_circuit_v` | V | input | yes | Resting voltage of a freshly charged battery (no load). Sims use this as the starting voltage. |
| parameter | `battery.internal_resistance_ohm` | ohm | measured | yes | Battery + wiring + switch resistance: voltage drop per amp drawn. Fit from HardwareMonitor sessions (profile import-monitor). |
| parameter | `battery.capacity_mah` | mAh | input |  | Rated battery capacity. |
| parameter | `battery.voltage_drop_per_ah` | V/Ah | input |  | How far the resting voltage falls per amp-hour used. |
| parameter | `battery.end_of_match_v` | V | measured |  | Typical resting voltage after a full match. |
| curve | `battery.voltage_vs_current` | A -> V | measured | yes | Battery terminal voltage vs total current (sag), binned from HardwareMonitor sessions. |
| curve | `battery.voltage_vs_match_time` | s -> V | measured |  | Battery voltage through a logged session. |

### `power`

Current draw of the whole robot (measured).

| type | name | unit | role | req | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| parameter | `power.avg_current_a` | A | measured |  | Average total current over a match. |
| parameter | `power.peak_current_a` | A | measured |  | Highest total current seen (95th percentile of samples). |
| parameter | `power.min_battery_v` | V | measured |  | Lowest battery voltage seen under load. |

### `drive`

Mecanum drivetrain build, motors, traction, and the resulting speed/acceleration.

| type | name | unit | role | req | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| parameter | `drive.wheel_diameter_m` | m | input | yes | Mecanum wheel diameter. |
| parameter | `drive.track_width_m` | m | input | yes | Distance between left and right wheel centers. |
| parameter | `drive.wheelbase_m` | m | input | yes | Distance between front and back wheel centers. |
| parameter | `drive.gear_ratio` | ratio | input | yes | Extra reduction from the motor output shaft to the wheel (1 = wheel on the motor shaft, 2 = wheel turns half as fast). |
| parameter | `drive.motor_free_speed_rpm` | rpm | input | yes | Drive motor free speed at its output shaft (gearbox included) at nominal voltage, from the datasheet. |
| parameter | `drive.motor_stall_torque_nm` | N*m | input | yes | Drive motor stall torque at its output shaft at nominal voltage (kg*cm x 0.0981). |
| parameter | `drive.motor_stall_current_a` | A | input | yes | Drive motor stall current at nominal voltage. |
| parameter | `drive.motor_free_current_a` | A | input | yes | Drive motor free (no-load) current at nominal voltage. |
| parameter | `drive.motor_nominal_v` | V | input |  | Voltage the motor datasheet is quoted at. |
| parameter | `drive.wheel_friction_coeff` | mu | input | yes | Wheel-to-tile friction coefficient. Limits acceleration (traction). |
| parameter | `drive.strafe_efficiency` | fraction | input | yes | Strafing speed and force relative to driving forward (mecanum roller losses), 0-1. |
| parameter | `drive.rolling_resistance_coeff` | fraction | input |  | Rolling + scrub resistance as a fraction of robot weight. |
| parameter | `drive.current_limit_a` | A | input |  | Per-motor current limit (software or hub). Empty = no limit. |
| parameter | `drive.max_power` | fraction | input |  | Software cap on drive motor power (1 = full). |
| parameter | `drive.zero_power_brake` | flag | input |  | 1 = motors BRAKE at zero power, 0 = FLOAT. |
| parameter | `drive.encoder_ticks_per_rev` | ticks | input |  | Encoder counts per motor output-shaft revolution (needed to turn HardwareMonitor velocity into m/s). |
| parameter | `drive.motor_names` | text | input |  | Comma-separated drive motor names in the robot configuration (used by profile import-monitor), e.g. leftFront,rightFront,leftBack,rightBack. |
| parameter | `drive.path_overhead_factor` | ratio | input | yes | Real path-following time divided by the physics-limited time from the sims (>= 1). Measure: time a real path / sim prediction. |
| parameter | `drive.max_speed_mps` | m/s | derived | yes | Top forward speed on a full battery. |
| parameter | `drive.max_strafe_speed_mps` | m/s | derived | yes | Top sideways speed on a full battery. |
| parameter | `drive.max_turn_rate_dps` | deg/s | derived | yes | Top turning rate on a full battery. |
| parameter | `drive.max_accel_mps2` | m/s^2 | derived | yes | Peak forward acceleration from rest (traction or motor limited). |
| parameter | `drive.max_decel_mps2` | m/s^2 | derived | yes | Peak deceleration when reversing power at top speed. |
| parameter | `drive.time_to_max_speed_s` | s | derived |  | Time from rest to 95% of top speed at full power. |
| parameter | `drive.peak_current_a` | A | derived |  | Peak total drive current (all 4 motors) accelerating from rest. |
| parameter | `drive.cruise_current_a` | A | derived |  | Total drive current holding top speed. |
| parameter | `drive.measured_top_speed_mps` | m/s | measured |  | Highest drive wheel speed seen in HardwareMonitor sessions. |
| curve | `drive.speed_vs_time` | s -> m/s | derived |  | Speed from rest at full power, full battery. |
| curve | `drive.current_vs_time` | s -> A | derived |  | Total drive motor current from rest at full power. |
| curve | `drive.current_vs_speed` | m/s -> A | derived | yes | Total drive current at full power vs speed (current falls as the robot speeds up). |
| curve | `drive.time_to_distance` | m -> s | derived | yes | Fastest stop-to-stop time driving forward (accelerate, then brake). Physics limit: multiply by drive.path_overhead_factor for real paths. |
| curve | `drive.strafe_time_to_distance` | m -> s | derived | yes | Fastest stop-to-stop time strafing sideways. |
| curve | `drive.time_to_turn` | deg -> s | derived | yes | Fastest stop-to-stop time turning in place. |
| curve | `drive.top_speed_vs_battery_v` | V -> m/s | derived | yes | How top speed falls as the battery drains. |
| curve | `drive.max_accel_vs_battery_v` | V -> m/s^2 | derived | yes | How peak acceleration falls as the battery drains. |
| surface | `drive.time_to_distance_vs_battery` | m, V -> s | derived |  | Stop-to-stop forward time by distance and battery. |
| distribution | `drive.path_end_error_m` | m per move | input |  | Distance between where a path should end and where the robot stops. |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| parameter | `launcher.motor_count` | count | input | yes | Motors driving the flywheel. |
| parameter | `launcher.gear_ratio` | ratio | input | yes | Motor shaft speed / flywheel speed (0.5 = flywheel spins twice as fast as the motor). |
| parameter | `launcher.motor_free_speed_rpm` | rpm | input | yes | Launcher motor free speed at its output shaft at nominal voltage. |
| parameter | `launcher.motor_stall_torque_nm` | N*m | input | yes | Launcher motor stall torque at its output shaft. |
| parameter | `launcher.motor_stall_current_a` | A | input | yes | Launcher motor stall current. |
| parameter | `launcher.motor_free_current_a` | A | input | yes | Launcher motor free current. |
| parameter | `launcher.motor_nominal_v` | V | input |  | Voltage the launcher motor datasheet is quoted at. |
| parameter | `launcher.friction_torque_nm` | N*m | input |  | Extra drag at the flywheel (belts, bearings) beyond the motors' own free current. |

| parameter | `launcher.voltage_compensation` | flag | input |  | 1 = feedforward scaled by 12 V / battery voltage, 0 = fixed. |
| parameter | `launcher.max_rpm` | rpm | input | yes | Highest flywheel speed the code will command. |

| parameter | `launcher.feed_interval_s` | s | input | yes | Minimum time between consecutive balls in a burst (feeder speed). |

| parameter | `match.auto_s` | s | input | yes | **30** (manual). AUTO period (10). |
| parameter | `match.transition_s` | s | input | yes | **8** (manual). Pause between AUTO and TELEOP (10). |
| parameter | `match.teleop_s` | s | input | yes | **120** (manual). TELEOP period (10). |
| parameter | `match.flower_window_s` | s | input | yes | **60** (manual). FLOWER scoring opens with this much time left (10). |

### `localization`

How the robot's believed position drifts from the truth.

| type | name | unit | role | req | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| parameter | `localization.method` | text | input |  | How the robot localizes, e.g. 'goBILDA Pinpoint, 2 pods + IMU' or 'drive encoders + IMU'. |
| parameter | `localization.scale_error_std` | fraction | input | yes | 1-sigma distance calibration error of the odometry (0.005 = 0.5%). |
| parameter | `localization.slip_std_per_sqrt_m` | m/sqrt(m) | input | yes | Random position error growth: 1-sigma error after 1 m of travel from slip and bumps. |
| parameter | `localization.gyro_bias_std_dps` | deg/s | input | yes | 1-sigma gyro bias left after calibration. |
| parameter | `localization.gyro_noise_deg_per_sqrt_s` | deg/sqrt(s) | input |  | Gyro random walk. |
| parameter | `localization.gyro_scale_std` | fraction | input |  | 1-sigma gyro scale error (heading error per degree turned). |
| parameter | `localization.vision_std_m` | m | input |  | 1-sigma position error of an AprilTag relocalization. Empty = no vision correction. |
| parameter | `localization.vision_interval_s` | s | input |  | Typical time between vision relocalizations. |
| parameter | `localization.position_error_after_match_m` | m | derived |  | RMS position error at the end of a full match of driving. |
| parameter | `localization.heading_error_after_match_deg` | deg | derived |  | RMS heading error at the end of a full match. |
| curve | `localization.position_error_vs_distance` | m -> m | derived | yes | How far off the believed position is after driving a distance (no vision fixes unless configured). |
| curve | `localization.position_error_vs_time` | s -> m | derived | yes | Position error through a match of typical driving. |
| curve | `localization.heading_error_vs_time` | s -> deg | derived | yes | Heading error through a match of typical driving. |
| curve | `localization.measured_position_error_vs_distance` | m -> m | measured |  | From logged real pose checks (profile import-poses), 0.5 m bins. |
| curve | `localization.measured_position_error_vs_time` | s -> m | measured |  | From logged real pose checks, 10 s bins. |
| distribution | `localization.pose_error_m` | m per shot | derived | yes | Error of the robot's believed position when it shoots, per axis (from the localization sim). |
| distribution | `localization.heading_error_deg` | deg per shot | derived |  | Error of the robot's believed heading when it shoots (from the localization sim); turns into aim error. |
